spans.s:
√mikṣ 'mix'
present: [3.] mimikṣvá -- [1.] mímikṣati etc. 
perfect: mimikṣáthus etc. mimikṣé mimikṣire 
secondary: causative: mekṣayati 
derivatives: miṣrá V.+ -miśla V.B. -míkṣā V.B.S. mékṣaṇa B.S. mimikṣú RV. 
Seems a desiderative formation to a simpler √miś; referred by the grammarians (and GR.) to √mih.
